summary: 기존 업로드에서 시작해 전체 채팅으로 생성 과정을 보여주고, 완료 후 왼쪽 PPT·오른쪽 같은 대화를 유지하는 ChatGPT형 UI를 적용한다.
invariants: Preserve upload setup; show generation in full-screen chat, then open PPT left and the same conversation right.
Use right-aligned user bubbles, unboxed assistant replies, compact attachments and collapsed request settings.
Use one message-list scroll region and a fixed composer; retain drafts and reading position across layout changes.
Show actual progress and inline errors once; terminal states stop animations and follow indicators.
Use an 800px conversation and an initial approximate 65:35 PPT/chat split subject to usable panel widths.
Expose retry, stop and download actions only when supported by current server state and artifact availability.
forbidden: Reset the conversation on the generation-to-PPT transition.
Treat the v3 design or historical v2 tests as completed v3 implementation.
